text: Databases store and organise information so that applications can use it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases keep data in tables with rows and columns, which makes them perfect for structured information. NoSQL databases are more flexible and suit changing or unstructured data. To get useful answers from a database, you write queries. Good data modeling helps you plan how information connects before you build anything. Indexes are also important because they make searches much faster, especially when tables grow large. Understanding these basics helps you choose the right database for your project.
